title: Balancing Quality and Variation: Spam Filtering Distorts Data Label Distributions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating how automated spam filtering heuristics (such as MACE, CrowdTruth, and inter-annotator agreement metrics) disproportionately penalize and remove valid annotators who disagree with the majority, by measuring the resulting degradation in label diversity, entropy, and standard deviation on subjective annotation datasets.
